message.content: Yes, based on the conversation provided in source 1, Li Hua did request to change his class from Thursday to Friday. In the message dated 20260211_19:00, Li Hua writes, "Hey Jennifer! Sorry for the last-minute change, but I have an unexpected work meeting tomorrow. Can we reschedule our training session to Friday instead? Let me know if that works for you. Thanks!" This indicates that Li Hua initially sought to move their training session from a Thursday to a Friday, which Jennifer Moore agreed to. Therefore, Li Hua did indeed ask Jennifer for permission to change the class from Thursday to Friday.
